title: How to organize the school and activity launch zone | Kids Bedroom
description:
The square metre by the bedroom door where tomorrow morning gets assembled the night before.

This is the School and Activity Launch Zone in the Kids Bedroom. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Backpack hanging on its hook at child height, packed and zipped. Shoes side by side directly underneath it. Signed forms in the front pocket rather than on the kitchen counter. Sports bag on the second hook, instrument case upright against the wall. Floor completely clear.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Empty the backpack completely every Friday, turned upside down.
Straighten: Hook, then shoes, then bag, along the wall in the order they get grabbed.
Shine: Wipe the lunchbox seals and the inside of the water bottle lid, which is where the mould actually grows.
Safety: A bag left in a dark doorway at seven in the morning is the trip that starts the day badly, so everything hang
Standardize: A five line checklist taped beside the hook at the child's eye level, in pictures for a younger one and words
Sustain: The launch zone gets packed while the bath is running, every school night, so it happens before anyone is tire

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Bag on the hook, shoes underneath, forms in the front pocket, and the five line checklist taped beside the hook at the child's eye level.
